اعتصرنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرْنَا (iʕtaṣarnā) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرْنَا (uʕtuṣirnā) /uʕ.tu.sˤir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
